crossRefs.note: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and…
crossRefs.keyword: Beer-sheba. i.e., the well of the oath

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

translations.web: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.
translations.bsb: So he called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the city is Beersheba.
translations.kjv: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
translations.asv: And he called it Shibah. Therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.
